title: Warm British Sausages Full English Breakfast
description: A fresh and comforting British dish featuring Cornish sausages, confit tomatoes, and a hint of cinnamon, perfect for a low-fat friendly breakfast.

ingredients.name: Cornish sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably made with pork and seasonings

ingredients.name: confit tomatoes
ingredients.notes: made with fresh tomatoes and olive oil

ingredients.name: low-fat cooking oil
ingredients.notes: such as olive or canola oil

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the Cornish sausages in a large skillet over medium heat, browning them on all sides.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the confit tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the sausages and mushrooms.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork, then season with salt, pepper, and ground cinnamon.
Pour the eggs over the sausage and mushroom mixture in the skillet and scramble them together.
Toast the bread slices and place them on a tagliere or large platter.
Arrange the sausage and egg mixture on top of the toasted bread slices.
Drizzle the low-fat cooking oil over the top of the dish and serve hot.
